description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'git fetch' with negative refspecs. It includes setup commands, cloning repositories, and executing various fetch and push commands with different refspec configurations, particularly focusing on negative refspecs such as ^refs/heads/branch, ^commit-sha, and patterns involving ^. It appears to be a test script for Git's refspec handling.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the current repository.
